_about: Domain-specific suggestions shown on /trends when a metric needs attention. Food ideas only; not medical advice.

fiber_low.title: Fiber looks low
fiber_low.tip: Try adding one of these to a meal most days.
foods: Fruits such as apple, orange or guava

protein_low.title: Protein looks low
protein_low.tip: Add a protein source to breakfast or lunch.

fruit_veg_low.title: Few fruits and vegetables logged
fruit_veg_low.tip: Aim to include produce in more meals.
foods: Amla, orange or guava for vitamin C

sodium_high.title: Sodium is running high
sodium_high.tip: Swap a frequent salty item for a lower-sodium one.
foods: Roasted makhana instead of chips or namkeen
Home-cooked dal with less added salt
Fresh vegetables instead of instant noodles
Skip papad or pickle on some days

sugar_high.title: Added sugar is running high
sugar_high.tip: Replace one sweet item a day.
foods: Whole fruit instead of packaged juice
Plain curd instead of sweetened desserts

processed_high.title: Many processed foods
processed_high.tip: Cook or choose minimally processed options more often.
foods: Poha, idli or upma instead of packaged snacks

diversity_low.title: Low food variety
diversity_low.tip: Rotate grains, legumes and vegetables through the week.

vitamin_c_low.title: Vitamin C sources
vitamin_c_low.tip: Foods commonly rich in vitamin C.
